args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
All done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`), and the service is now **healthy** with error rate 0.002.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: Created incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") documenting the failure, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the need to investigate the v2.3.1 regression. (The initial API call timed out, but I verified the incident was created successfully.)

Note: v2.3.1 remains the latest release; it should not be redeployed until the regression is root-caused and fixed.
